profiles.name: Unknown / generic
profiles.guidance: Preserve the subject and append plain visual language. Negative-prompt and encoder capabilities are unknown; choose an explicit profile before conditioning.

profiles.name: SDXL
profiles.guidance: Concise visual tags, optional negative prompt. The same text can feed both CLIP encoders; native SDXL encoding remains available for separate encoder text and size conditioning. Weighting is a ComfyUI encoder capability, not a universal model syntax.

profiles.name: FLUX image
profiles.guidance: Describe subject, action, style, context and light in natural language. Negative prompts are unsupported in this profile. Keep model-specific guidance and encoder selection in the native FLUX workflow.

profiles.name: Qwen-Image (CFG)
profiles.guidance: Use descriptive captions and quote exact requested lettering. Negative text requires a workflow that actually enables classifier-free guidance. Use the separate Qwen-Image 2.1 profile for its guidance-free default; image editing needs native image-aware encoding.

profiles.name: Qwen-Image 2.1 (no CFG)
profiles.guidance: Use natural language for the requested result. This profile follows the guidance-free 2.1 default and suppresses ineffective negative text. Explicit CFG-enabled workflows can use a custom profile; edits require the native image-aware encoder.

profiles.name: MOSS-Image SFT / Base
profiles.guidance: Use complete captions with lighting, materials and exact visible text. The full model supports optional negatives when guidance is enabled. Native JSON layouts are a separate workflow; this profile does not invent boxes or rewrite layouts.

profiles.name: MOSS-Image DMD (CFG 1)
profiles.guidance: Natural captions for a DMD/DMD2 workflow running at CFG 1. There is no negative branch; styling never changes the installed adapter, sampler, steps or guidance.

profiles.name: Anima Base / Aesthetic
profiles.guidance: Lowercase tags with spaces, natural language, or a mixture. Aesthetic does not need score tags. No quality boosters, artist identities or safety labels are inserted automatically. Photographic styles are excluded because the model targets illustration.

profiles.name: Anima Turbo (CFG 1)
profiles.guidance: Use descriptive tags or mixed captions without automatic score tags. This profile follows Turbo at CFG 1, so negative text is suppressed; it does not choose a step count or modify the user workflow.

profiles.name: Fibo 2 structured caption
profiles.guidance: Export model-caption fields from the supplied subject and explicit style axes. Existing user caption fields take priority. The text negative interface is intentionally unsupported: native Fibo negatives are structured captions. Use native Fibo encoding and inspect the caption; no scene objects or coordinates are inferred.

profiles.name: Fibo 2 instruction edit
profiles.guidance: Keep edit instructions in natural language. Existing structured captions retain edit_instruction and protected caption fields. Use the native image-aware Fibo edit encoder; this profile never invents scene objects.
